newsitem.title: USA: Florida Panthers chief to sell 5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Florida Panthers chief to sell 5 mln shrs.

text.p: Florida Panthers Holdings Inc said Tuesday in a filing with the Securities and Exchange commission that Chairman H. Wayne Huizenga will sell up to 5,020,678 Class A common shares.
After the offering, outstanding Class A shares will total 12,320,678, and Class B common will total 255,000, for a total of 12,575,678 common shares.
The Fort Lauderdale, Fla.-based company owns and operates the Florida Panthers, a professional ice hockey team in the National Hockey League.
